content:
Role: Linguist (compression & naming agent)
Task: Bridge the session ID systems.
The TUI sessions have UUIDs stored in ~/cli-synthegration/conv_repo/sessions/.
The message_index.json has different keys (e.g. "it", "refactor").
Create a Python script (bridge_session_ids.py) that, for a given TUI session UUID,
finds its messages in message_index.json by matching the session's display_name
or by examining the export data in conv_repo.
Output the script in ~/sandbox/session_bridge/.
Use funcfind and jq to inspect the data structures first.
